createdByUser.description: The information of the {@link User} that created it.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

fileUrl.description: The relative URL of attached document used by File API to upload and download document. Starts with `/file/`.

asset.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset} associated with this document.

imageFile.description: File containing image for the Subsystem

displayUrl.description: URL field useable in the UI.

externalurl.description: This is typically used to link to an external resource or website associated with the document.
